captions.detailed: An upright, vintage-style casino slot machine featuring a tall dark brown cabinet with a golden-yellow and black front faceplate. The front includes a clear window displaying three parallel white reels, a black lower panel, and a small silver payout tray flap at the bottom. A silver pull lever with a bright red spherical knob is mounted on the right side of the cabinet. The three reels rotate continuously on horizontal axes, the side lever rotates on a revolute joint, and the payout tray flap pivots on a small lower hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a classic upright slot machine cabinet with a front-facing window, three parallel spinning reels, a side-mounted pull lever with a red knob, and a hinged payout tray flap at the bottom. The cabinet should have a dark brown exterior with a yellow and black front interface, and the joints should allow continuous rotation of the reels, revolute rotation of the side lever, and a limited revolute rotation for the payout tray flap.
captions.factory: The slot machine is constructed by first creating a tall main cabinet using box primitives for the outer housing, front faceplate, and window frames. The side lever is built from a cylinder for the shaft, a bent arm, and a sphere for the red handle, attached via a revolute joint. Three identical cylinders are modeled for the reels and positioned side-by-side behind the window cutouts using continuous rotational joints. Finally, a small rectangular box represents the payout tray flap at the lower front, attached with a revolute joint to simulate its opening and closing action.
